blind.description: A conical mound of chunky, angular rocks and rubble. Larger faceted stone blocks form the central peak and upper slope, while smaller stones and gravel cluster along the ground perimeter. The geometry is solid and low-poly stylized with painted rock textures in shades of earthy brown, tan, and dark grey. The base sits directly flat on the ground plane without an artificial plinth or stand.
blind.from_above: A roughly circular cluster of angular brown-grey rocks with a peaked center, tapering outward to smaller stones around the outer edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the figure (around 3 feet tall) and roughly 4 to 5 feet wide at the base.
